title: Counter-Mine 2
description: The only real CS2 in Minecraft without mods
body:
# 🎯Counter-Mine 2

We are a Minecraft server featuring a **full** CS2 gameplay experience — **no mods required.**

## 🔫 Gameplay
We have carefully reproduced the core mechanics of the game:
- **Weapon spread and recoil**
- **Wall penetration**
- **Grenade physics**
- And many other mechanics

The mechanics are recreated using the **original formulas** from CS2

![Gameplay](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/e6fO2FFZ/images/ae84b65b1223157d783613f5927696362d708cad.webp)

## 🗺️ Maps
Every map has been rebuilt **meter by meter**, which means:
- Original timings are preserved
- Grenade lineups are preserved

![Maps](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fdd57d638918836f4e8da4e76fd59c173c15c3d8.webp)

---

💣 **The full CS2 experience inside Minecraft — without installing any mods.**
